name: Tamura Corporation
summary: Tamura Corporation manufactures and sells electronic components, electronic chemical packaging, and information equipment in Japan, China, other Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers electronic components, including transformers, reactors, choke coils, gate drivers, isolated DC-DC converter module, current sensors, high voltage power supplies, bolt-clamped langevin type transducers, SOLIDFORMER relay, piezoelectric transformer, transducers, and ultrasonic sensors products.
